blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) on Tuesday ordered an investigation and an intensified manhunt against the individuals involved in the death of a police chief of Bubong, Lanao del Sur. According to the PNP, Police Major Razul Guimbangan Pandulo was inside his apartment in Barangay Poblacion when two suspects reportedly shot him at about 4:30 p.m. on Monday.
